title: Root-probe harness times out spawning pwsh to read a fixture ACL under host load
outcome: Root-probe harness times out spawning pwsh to read a fixture ACL under host load
acceptance: scripts/root-probe-harness.mjs no longer depends on spawning pwsh per fixture ACL read within a fixed timeout ('a create-denied root still resolves host identity, and agent/MCP succeed, without a WARNING' must not fail with spawnSync pwsh ETIMEDOUT): the ACL read avoids a per-read pwsh spawn, or its wait is bounded by a cause-specific limit with a distinct diagnostic. A deterministic test injects a slow or blocked ACL reader and shows the harness behaves correctly; no synthetic or concurrent full-gate load is used as evidence (Greg #1112)

completion.summary: Root probes reuse one bounded fixture-owned pwsh ACL reader with separate startup/read/close diagnostics, deterministic lifecycle tests and preserved ACL restoration/canaries.
